minibatch_selection: first original Memory.get_batch_generator minibatch after restoring checkpoint CPU Python/NumPy/Torch RNG; no filtering
targets: original Agent.compute_targets over complete same-version episode buffer; normalize advantages over that full buffer exactly as Agent.learn
optimizer_restore: both original checkpoint Adam states on CPU, no fresh-state fallback
execution: byte-identical independent Agent.learn; read-only measurements around original clipping/step calls; progress_callback raises a handled stop after the first completed logical minibatch

response_screens.raw_repeat_comparison: report TV(pre,post) and TV(pre,repeat) without hiding tiny changes
response_screens.conservative_float32_screen: TV(pre,post) > max(10*TV(pre,repeat), 1e-6); engineering numerical screen, not meaningful learning or policy-quality threshold

stops: 600 second cumulative single-CPU ceiling including reserve
no rerun of optimizer steps already entered in the durable step ledger
limits: CPU replay is not bitwise historical CUDA replay
interrupted learn does not increment full-update policy_version
one minibatch is not a complete historical PPO update
no expert/value labels for candidate quality
no extra epoch, seed, architecture, reward, or GPU job
